# OpenAngels

> OpenAngels is an open directory and intelligence platform of 10,400+ early-stage angel investors, venture capital funds, and startup syndicates.

## Mission & Purpose
OpenAngels helps startup founders find, evaluate, and connect with active angel investors without paying recurring monthly subscription fees. Founders can filter investors by sector (90+ industries including AI, SaaS, Fintech, Healthcare, Consumer, Hardware, Web3), stage (Pre-seed, Seed, Series A), check size ($5k to $1M+), and geography (Silicon Valley, New York, London, Europe, Global).

## Core Data & Services
- **10,400+ Verified Investor Dossiers**: Detailed investment thesis, confirmed typical check sizes, preferred stages, backed startups, and verified direct contact details.
- **Programmatic Directory Hubs**: Curated thematic directories categorized by sector, investment stage, and geography for targeted fundraising.
- **Company Portfolio Intelligence**: Verified lists of angel backers and early investors behind iconic technology companies (OpenAI, Stripe, Figma, Airbnb, Uber, etc.).
- **AI Cold Email Pitch Assistant**: Personalized outreach generator tailored to each investor's portfolio and focus sectors.
